definitions.explanation: A bank that does business mainly over the internet and has few or no branches. Customers use an app or website and withdraw cash at convenience-store ATMs; fees are usually lower and interest higher than at ordinary banks.

examples.japanese: ネット{銀行|ぎんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
ネット{銀行|ぎんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I opened an account with an online bank.

examples.japanese: ネット{銀行|ぎんこう}なら、⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{振|ふ}り{込|こ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できて→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: With an online bank you can make transfers on your phone even in the middle of the night, which is handy.

notes:
⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧ (internet) + ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧ (bank). Also called ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧バンク.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ネット{銀行|ぎんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧: an online bank account
- ネット{銀行|ぎんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{振|ふ}り{込|こ}む→振り込む：10992_furikomu⟧: to make a transfer with an online bank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧バンキング: online banking, a service that ordinary banks also offer; a ネット{銀行|ぎんこう} is a bank that exists mainly online
